title: Dallas Fed Texas Manufacturing Outlook Survey (Nov 2026 data)
source: EST: dallasfed.org's Texas Manufacturing Outlook Survey page, fetched direct 2026-09-05 — it gives the 2026 release calendar as Jan 26, Feb 23, Mar 30, Apr 27, May 26, Jun 29, Jul 27, Aug 31, Sep 28, Oct 26, November 30, Dec 28 and states that 'the publishing process begins at 9:30 a.m. CT' (10:30 ET). Independently consistent with the series' observed last-Monday-of-month cadence (2026-11-30 is November's last Monday) and with the 10:30 ET time the dallas-fed-mfg-2026-09-28 entry derived from a secondary on 2026-09-01, when this same publisher page returned HTTP 403. Filed estimate on three counts: the primary was read through a summarizing fetcher rather than quoted verbatim from the table, its availability is demonstrably intermittent (403 on 09-01, served on 09-05), and this lane never self-promotes an adjacency it discovered in-sweep. There is also no confirmed-tier source prefix for a reserve-bank survey in the source table at all
notes: The regional analog that lands 45 minutes after the Chicago print on the same morning, and the reason to read the two together: on 2026-08-28 Chicago collapsed to 47.1 (-10.5pt) and three days later this survey printed the mirror image — general business activity 11.6 from 1.3 (a Jan-2025 high), production 16.1 from 10.1, new orders 22.0 from 6.4. Tracking only the analog that missed low leaves the calendar structurally primed to see soft manufacturing signals and not firm ones, which is the selection bias the dallas-fed-mfg-2026-09-28 entry was created to remove. Kept `low`, not `medium` like Chicago, for that entry's reason unchanged: a single-state survey leading the national ISM by a full month is context, not a leading indicator of the next print. The 2026-11-30 instance carries one extra property — the chicago-pmi-2026-11-30 research established that no BEA, Census or BLS release is scheduled that morning (Thanksgiving pulls the month-end 08:30 block to 11-25/11-27), so Chicago 09:45 and this survey 10:30 are the session's only two scheduled macro releases, and the 09:45-09:50 measurement window that ledger's forward tests use closes 40 minutes before this one lands. Discovered during the chicago-pmi-2026-11-30 initial-research adjacency sweep (2026-09-05).
